data.define: Short for "not gonna lie", before an honest opinion.

misuse.text: Don't use 'ngl' in a job application.

native.tip: “ngl” = sem mentira. Exemplo: “Ngl, I loved that movie.”
native.caption:
O que significa “ngl”?
“ngl” = sem mentira.
Exemplo: “Ngl, I loved that movie.” ("Ngl", eu amei aquele filme.)
